exposure: type of healthcare facility (hospital vs health center)
presence of support persons during childbirth
cohort: Pregnant women in the Gamo Gofa Zone in Southwest Ethiopia
finding: Overall client satisfaction with maternity care was good (79.1%), but women attending health centers were more likely satisfied than those attending hospitals, and satisfaction was higher among those who had support persons during childbirth, delivered via cesarean section, and did not have to pay for services.
mod_finding: Women who delivered with caesarean section are four times more likely satisfied than those who deliver vaginally.
